This article aims to give a comprehensive overview of the Howard County Circuit Court's role, functioning, and services provided to the public.

Address of the New Howard County Circuit Court

The new Howard County Circuit Court is located at 9250 Judicial Way, Ellicott City, MD 21043. The court's new building is spacious, modern, and equipped with the latest technology to provide efficient services to the public.

Case Search at the Howard County Circuit Court

The Howard County Circuit Court provides online access to court records, making it easy for people to search for case information. To access the court's case search feature, you need to visit their website and follow the instructions provided. You can search for cases by case number, party name, or attorney name.

Judges at the Howard County Circuit Court

The Howard County Circuit Court has several judges who preside over cases and ensure that justice is upheld. The judges are appointed by the Governor of Maryland and confirmed by the Maryland Senate. Some of the judges serving at the Howard County Circuit Court are:

  • Richard S. Bernhardt
  • Timothy J. McCrone
  • Mary M. Kramer
  • Diane O. Leasure
  • William V. Tucker III

Phone Number of the Howard County Circuit Court

If you need to contact the Howard County Circuit Court, you can call them at (410) 313-2111. The court's staff will be able to assist you with any questions or concerns you may have.

Family Division of the Howard County Circuit Court

The Howard County Circuit Court has a Family Division that handles cases related to family law. The Family Division deals with issues such as divorce, child custody, child support, and adoption. The division has specialized judges and staff who are trained to handle these types of cases.

Howard County Superior Court 3

It is important to note that there is no Howard County Superior Court 3. The Howard County Circuit Court is the highest court in Howard County, and all cases are heard there.

Conclusion

The Howard County Circuit Court is an integral part of Maryland's judicial system, and its role in resolving legal disputes and upholding justice cannot be overstated. Despite facing various challenges, the court continues to provide valuable services to the community and has made significant strides in incorporating technology and innovation. It is essential to recognize the critical role played by the court and support its efforts in the interest of justice.

FAQs

How can I find information about a case in the Howard County Circuit Court?

Ans: The Howard County Circuit Court provides online access to court records. You can search for case information on their website or visit the court in person.

Can I file a case online in the Howard County Circuit Court?

Ans: Yes, the court allows electronic filing for certain types of cases. You can find more information on their website.

How are judges appointed to the Howard County Circuit Court?

Ans: Judges are appointed by the Governor of Maryland and confirmed by the Maryland Senate.

Can I represent myself in court?

Ans: Yes, you can represent yourself in court, but it is always advisable to seek legal counsel.

How can I volunteer at the Howard County Circuit Court?

Ans: The court offers various volunteer opportunities. You can contact them for more information.
